reason: The first-eight-per-category task set had a non-degenerate dominance predictor but only 1/32 tasks changed structural class or top eligible candidate between arms.
studyRole: Outcome-blind mechanism stress-test sampling; it does not estimate the population prevalence of recommendation-induced action divergence.

sourcePool.taskOrder: Sort eligible tasks by frozen taskId within category.
sourcePool.modelFamily: Assign SASRec to even full-pool task indices and GRU4Rec to odd indices.
sourcePool.modelSeed: Assign seeds 7, 17, and 29 cyclically by full-pool task index.

selectionAlgorithm.opportunityPriority: Within each stratum, select up to two opportunityChanged tasks, ordered by ascending minimumArmDecisionSeparation and then taskId.
selectionAlgorithm.coverageFill: Until four tasks are selected, choose the remaining task that maximizes its minimum absolute predictor distance from already selected tasks; if no task is yet selected, choose the smallest predictor. Break ties by taskId.
selectionAlgorithm.finalOrder: Category order from the protocol, then modelFamily, then taskId.

selectionGates.balance: Exactly 32 tasks, 8 per category, and 4 per category-by-modelFamily stratum.
selectionGates.opportunity: At least 8/32 selected tasks must change structural class or top eligible candidate between arms.
selectionGates.distinctValues: At least 12 distinct minimumArmDecisionSeparation values after rounding to six decimals.
selectionGates.largestPointMass: No predictor value may cover more than 50% of selected tasks.
selectionGates.dispersion: Selected-task predictor population standard deviation must be at least 0.15.
selectionGates.determinism: All 460 models must be in evaluation mode, every state must pass three-call repeatability, and the selected manifest plus aggregate state hash must match across fresh processes.

decisionRules.go: All selection gates pass. Freeze and commit the generated public task manifest before any LLM call.
decisionRules.noGo: Any selection gate fails. Do not call an LLM and do not relax the gate after seeing the screen.
decisionRules.pilotClaimBoundary: A passing repair pilot can establish the proposed mechanism on opportunity-enriched tasks, not its frequency in the original task population.

privacy: Public pool and selected rows contain frozen task hashes and derived state metrics only; no original item IDs, candidate aliases, titles, reviews, prompts, responses, or outcomes.
